page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A key characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, consisting of a 959 GB SSD. This local storage is bundled directly with the instance, providing high-speed local data access. For network connectivity, the server offers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, supporting stable data transfer rates for connected applications.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dedicated Intel Xeon cores alongside substantial local SSD storage and an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio offers a balanced resource profile for data-intensive tasks without requiring external block storage attachments. This configuration is suitable for local database hosting, caching layers, medium-scale transactional applications, and workloads requiring fast local read and write operations.
